name: dev-docker-delete-a-tag-under-a-push-use
why: Control: deleting the latest manifest under a use to push a PR tag.

job.purpose: docker push ghcr.io/acme/web:pr-61: push the image built from my PR

User-Agent: docker/27.3.1 go/go1.22.7 git-commit/41ca978 kernel/6.8.0 os/linux arch/amd64

statements: allow push on image tag "acme/web:pr-61" in registry "ghcr.io"

definitions.image tag: A tag of a container image repository, repository:tag.
definitions.push: Upload an image's blobs and manifest to the registry so the tag names it.
definitions.registry: A container registry, by its host.
